notes.title: Perks Update! v0.85
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Tinfoil here!



Its been a bit more than a week since the early access release and I'm happy to have gotten alot of feedback over these days. This update will be adding the Perk System to the game in preparation for all the future progression system the game will have. The next couple of updates will focus on fixing more issues that might come from this. But other than that, listening to the players and making updates as they feel the game needs!



- Perks!

	- Characters have their own minor perk

	- Major perks can be unlocked in the perk tab in the character page. 2 can be equipped at a time

- New Achievements:

	- Getting Started

	- Refused Service

	- Wet Boy

	- Careful!

- Two New Cosmetics

	- Big Sword

	- The Guzzler

- Fixed Yummy! Achievement not being able to trigger

- Expert Achievement Scoring adjustments

- Fixed Steam Achievement not always triggering alongside the in-game achievements

- Cut chicken and diced fish locked until 3-3. When they are needed

- Removed Super hearing endless perk (Now a player perk)

- Jealous Customers Nerf. 5 second debuff -> 10 seconds

- New Endless perk: Hammer (Move any gameplay station)

- Popular Business nerf: Increased value 2 -> 1 

- Increased Endless difficulty base across all maps

- Grandmaster Cook is needed for galaxy chef hat now instead of Star Chef

- Endless perks properly work for choice limits

- Fixed bug where placing a food piece into a pot while on a crane would cause infinite food

- Fixed bug where starting another day with a pot on the stove would take the pot off of the stove

- Throwing a dirty dish near the sink will trigger it's auto-catch, instead of needing to start further away

- Fixed polaroid not working for clients

- Fixed jumping from aircannon, geyser stopping your momentum

- Max frame rate is now capped to your monitor, instead of a hard cap of 240

notes.title: Foodslingers Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hey Kenny here, aka Tinfoil



We are all excited to release this game to everyone and we hope that you all enjoy it as much as we do.



I, with the help of my friends have been developing this game on our free time over the past year. We made this in the goal of building a experience that creates memories between friends by challenging them in a way that requires strong teamwork. I really do mean it when I say that feedback and suggestions will affect the game as we just want to build a fun experience for players.



If you guys have suggestions, feedback, or bug reports. I strongly encourage you join the Discord at

https://discord.gg/WvQKEUu2Bg to let us know! Otherwise, let it be known in the Steam Forums



In addition to the discord, we intend to set up events or polls. To help decide what cosmetics, achievements, and features you guys want in the game



Issues with the game is mostly multiplayer focused. There are edge case issues that may occur when doing actions at the same time for players or things not syncing up. If any large glitches or bugs occurs. Having everyone quickly restart the game will likely resolve the issues.



Future Plans:

We plan to begin developing the 4th map, more characters, special mode updates, and endless mode changes (Be sure to give feedback on this one!).



Thank you,

Tinfoil
